title: Broker session: Job ownership, core delegation, STARTED after proof, natural COMPLETED
description:
SPIDR child 3c of 4, split from task-af3d7bc8af2146cf92d98557ed0e90c0 by architect-5aba94da. Human confirmed the 4-way split in the REPL. Carries parent DoD items 3 and 4.

DEPENDS ON task-05bf0e0fe7e84afb8584588ecf96db14 (3a: package, descriptors) and task-14ab762db8494959b93b070b9d3b3730 (3b: protocol vocabularies and framing). Do not start until BOTH are DONE, and RE-MEASURE their landed symbols before planning -- every prior task in this chain found a stale claim in its own description.

Objective: hold the Job, drive the core, and never publish a status frame the core has not actually proved.

Deliverable, inside packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/broker/:
- src/session.rs (NEW): owns the SOLE dedicated Job handle for one launch, builds the core's ProcessSpec from the validated launch request, duplicates only fd3/4/5 into the inherited allowlist, and delegates every Win32 operation to moe-windows-job-core. No Job or process syscall is restated here.
- src/main.rs: wire descriptors (3a) plus protocol (3b) plus session into the actual broker loop.
- tests/session.rs (NEW): scripted-call-table tests over the ordering guarantees below.

STARTED IS EARNED, NOT ANNOUNCED. It may be emitted on fd1 only after the core has proved, in order: exact Job limit flags, explicit assignment, membership, retained-handle process identity, and one successful resume. The core already returns each of these as a distinct fact; the session must consume those facts rather than infer success from the absence of an error. A test must fail each proof arm in turn and assert that STARTED never reaches fd1 -- absence from the recorded output, not merely that an error was returned.

NATURAL COMPLETION HAS FOUR PRECONDITIONS, ALL REQUIRED before handles close and COMPLETED is emitted: the retained root handle is waited, the exit is queried exactly, provider fd4 and fd5 reach EOF, and the Job reports ActiveProcesses==0. Any leg whose outcome is uncertain keeps the result UNKNOWN and must never be upgraded to COMPLETED. Note the core deliberately makes an exit code unconstructible without a confirmed signalled wait -- consume that type, do not work around it.

TERMINATION PATHS, each of which must terminate and reap EXACTLY ONCE and preserve UNKNOWN on any uncertain leg: CANCEL received on fd0, an instructed timeout, fd0 EOF, malformed control arriving AFTER a successful launch, and helper shutdown. Idempotence UNDER CONCURRENCY is 3d's, but each path individually terminating once is this task's.

NOT IN SCOPE: descriptor acquisition (3a), frame codec and vocabularies (3b), concurrent-idempotence and forcible-kill grandchild proofs and the final acceptance sweep (3d). No JavaScript, no daemon/store, no receipts, no public @moe/runner export.

Verification: cargo test --locked --manifest-path packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/Cargo.toml --target-dir dist/windows-job-native -p moe-windows-job-broker && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/Cargo.toml --target-dir dist/windows-job-native -p moe-windows-job-broker
definitionOfDone: STARTED reaches fd1 only after the core has proved exact Job limit flags, explicit assignment, membership, retained-handle process identity, and one successful resume. Proved by failing each of those arms in turn and asserting STARTED is ABSENT from the recorded fd1 output for every one -- absence from the stream, never merely that an error was returned.

The session owns the sole dedicated Job handle for a launch and restates no Win32 Job or process syscall: every such operation is delegated to moe-windows-job-core. Verified by grep that the broker contains no CreateJobObject, AssignProcessToJobObject, CreateProcessW, ResumeThread, TerminateProcess or WaitForSingleObject call site of its own.

COMPLETED is emitted only after ALL FOUR preconditions hold: the retained root handle waited, the exit queried exactly, provider fd4 and fd5 at EOF, and Job ActiveProcesses==0. Each precondition is failed independently in a test asserting COMPLETED is absent and the result stays UNKNOWN by its stable reason code -- four separate tests, not one combined path.
Every refusal frame emitted by the session carries only the exact stable operation and numeric Win32 code, never executable, argv, cwd, environment or handle data and never a free-form string.

Each of the five termination paths -- CANCEL on fd0, instructed timeout, fd0 EOF, malformed control after a successful launch, and helper shutdown -- terminates and reaps EXACTLY ONCE, asserted by a call-count table per path, and preserves UNKNOWN on any leg whose outcome could not be observed. Five distinct call-log assertions; a single shared path satisfying all five fails this item.

An exit code is never reported without the core's confirmed signalled-wait proof: the session consumes the core's type rather than reconstructing a code from a raw query. Verified by a test that supplies a still-running process and asserts the UNKNOWN reason code rather than a number.

Every Rust production source is <=250 physical lines by `grep -c ''` with counts recorded; the locked broker test and release build both exit 0; no executable, Cargo target output, transcript or generated smoke evidence is committed.
taskRails: The helper owns the sole dedicated Job handle. Closing it is crash safety, NOT success evidence: ordinary completion and cancel must query ActiveProcesses==0 before returning authority-neutral completion.

Delegate every Win32 lifecycle operation to moe-windows-job-core. Restating a Job or process syscall in the broker is a rail violation even where it looks simpler, and is separately checkable by grep.
STARTED, COMPLETED and REFUSED are earned from proved facts. Never infer success from the absence of an error, and never upgrade an UNKNOWN leg.
Refusals carry the closed operation vocabulary and a numeric Win32 code only; never echo executable, argv, cwd, environment or handle values.
Provider bytes on fd3/fd4/fd5 are never mixed with or parsed as control, and fd2 diagnostics is bounded and non-authoritative.
Keep every Rust production source focused, target and hard-cap <=250 physical lines; split before 400. Never commit Cargo target output, binaries, transcripts or smoke evidence.
Do not implement concurrent-idempotence proofs, the forcible-kill detached-grandchild proof, or the final acceptance sweep. Those belong to SPIDR sibling 3d.
